What we can simplify

A clear job.
A useful tool.

We ask what takes time, where information gets lost and what your team needs to see. The technology should make the work easier.

  1. 01

    Custom business tools

    Focused tools for tasks such as collecting requirements, preparing estimates or managing requests.

  2. 02

    Dashboards

    A shared view of the information your team needs, shaped around agreed data sources.

  3. 03

    Integrations

    Connections between the website, forms and services your business already uses.

  4. 04

    Google Analytics setup

    A measurement plan and implementation with agreed goals, such as enquiries or bookings.

Google Analytics & agreed goals

Better questions.
Clearer insights.

01

Agree the goals

Define useful actions, such as a completed enquiry or a booking, and decide how they can be measured.

02

Set up & check

Configure the agreed events and check that reports reflect the intended customer actions.

03

Review & improve

Read the reports alongside customer feedback and business context to identify the next improvement.

Useful technology.
Considered carefully.

Data sources, access, privacy and any consent requirements are considered as part of the agreed implementation. We choose the approach around the business, rather than adding complexity for its own sake.
